_comment: TrustFoundry public API search provider for case-name lookup. model_type=case_name is the dedicated case-name lookup lane; it returns a ranked, deduplicated page of the closest matching case names rather than a single exact answer. state_filter_enabled=true because case-name search requires a jurisdiction: the API rejects a case_name request with no `state`, exactly as it does for the four question-shaped model types.
